ENGINE – ENGINE MECHANICAL

13. REMOVE NO.1 TIMING BELT COVER
Remove the 5 bolts, timing belt cover and gasket.
14. REMOVE TIMING BELT GUIDE

P19955

15. REMOVE TIMING BELT
HINT (When re–using timing belt): Draw an arrow on the timing belt in the direction of engine revolution, and place matchmarks on the timing belt and crankshaft timing pulley.

P13096

16. REMOVE IDLER PULLEY
Using a 10 mm hexagon wrench, remove the pivot bolt, plate washer and idler pulley.

10mm
Hexagon
Wrench

P13088

2JZ–GTE

17. REMOVE CRANKSHAFT TIMING PULLEY
(a) 2JZ–GTE:
Remove the bolt and timing belt plate.

P18867

(b) Remove the crankshaft timing pulley.
If the pulley cannot be removed by hand, use SST to remove the crankshaft timing pulley.
SST 09950–50010 (09951–05010, 09952–05010,
09953–05020, 09954–00010)

SST

P18713
